# SLU Accessibility + Readability

Use during normal gameplay, UI, VFX, hazard, actor, and difficulty work.

## Workflow
1. Audit whether important states depend only on color, sound, tiny text, flash, or motion.
2. Give critical categories distinct silhouette, pattern, motion, timing, sound, or behavior before relying on palette.
3. Check contrast and text scaling on bright/dark gameplay backgrounds.
4. Provide Reduce Motion / Reduce Flash behavior that caps presentation without removing essential state information.
5. Preserve equivalent input paths for supported devices.
6. Keep important audio cues paired with non-audio information.
7. Test representative gameplay under accessibility settings, not only menus.

## Rules
Accessibility is part of the base design. It should preserve the game's logic, mastery, and competitive fairness where relevant rather than replacing challenges with unrelated behavior.
